claims.reason: service.ts and tunnel-service.ts derive loaded/running solely from result.status === 0, so ordinary nonzero launchctl print errors become loaded:false; direct setup, doctor, CLI, stop, restart, and uninstall callers branch on that value. Spawn errors and timeouts throw, but that counterevidence does not classify ordinary nonzero results.

service.ts getServiceStatus calls synchronous runCommand without timeout, while waitForServiceUnloaded checks its deadline only around the call; process.ts uses synchronous spawnSync. Tunnel status polling has a bounded print timeout, but that does not repair the daemon path or provide a uniform enclosing deadline.

service bootstrap and bootout run without timeout, and bootstrapService checks its deadline only before an unbounded synchronous attempt; restart holds a drain lease until the catch can run. Tunnel bootstrap and bootout also pass signal without a timeout.

Same evidenced root as review1 claim 1: ordinary nonzero launchctl print results become an unloaded status and reach lifecycle decisions. Existing thrown-error catches do not cover this nonzero-result path.

Same daemon status deadline root as review1 claim 2. Tunnel print probes and unload polling have bounded timeouts, so the accepted scope is the confirmed unbounded daemon status path; tunnel mutation timeout evidence is merged into L03.

roots.title: launchd nonzero print is misclassified as unloaded
roots.trigger: launchctl print returns an ordinary nonzero result for a permission, malformed-state, transport, or other error that is not a confirmed absent-service result.
roots.fix: Represent unknown separately and map only an exact recognized absence result to unloaded; fail closed in lifecycle and ownership decisions.

roots.title: Service status probes can exceed their enclosing deadline
roots.trigger: The daemon launchctl print blocks inside synchronous spawnSync while the caller is relying on an outer unload or lifecycle deadline.
roots.fix: Pass a timeout bounded by the enclosing deadline to every status probe and preserve timeout as unknown.

roots.title: launchd mutations can block lifecycle and drain compensation
roots.trigger: launchctl bootstrap or bootout stalls during install, start, stop, restart, or uninstall; restart can hold a drain lease until its catch path runs.
roots.fix: Bound every launchd mutation by the operation deadline and retain the primary mutation failure plus any compensation failure.
